First, note the date format is MM-DD-YYYY: 02-24-1100.  
Subtract 140 days:  

1100 is a common year (not divisible by 400, so not leap).  
From 02-24 back 24 days → 01-31 (31 days in Jan).  
140 total days: 24 days (Feb) + 31 (Jan) + 31 (Dec 1100) + 30 (Nov) + 24 left → 24 days into October from Oct 31: 1100-10-07.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1100-10-07
